profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
The Tirupati Assembly Constituency is one of the most prominent regions of Andhra Pradesh, known worldwide for the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, which attracts millions of pilgrims each year. Geographically, it is located at the foothills of the Seshachalam Hills, a biodiversity hotspot and home to the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve. The constituency also hosts other cultural and religious landmarks such as the Kapileswara Swamy Temple and Govindaraja Swamy Temple, reflecting its rich spiritual and cultural heritage. Alongside its religious importance, Tirupati is a strong center of education, with institutions like Sri Venkateswara University, Sri Padmavati Mahila University, and specialized institutes in medicine and Vedic studies.


Economically, Tirupati is driven mainly by the services sector, with tourism, education, hospitality, healthcare, and trade contributing the largest share. The constituency has strong transport infrastructure, including a major railway station, national highways, and an international airport, strengthening its connectivity to Chennai, Bangalore, and other cities. Social infrastructure is well developed, with renowned hospitals like SVIMS and Ruia Government General Hospital, alongside over 300 schools and 6 universities.
profile.geography: Tirupati constituency is located in Tirupati District and spans 280.91 Sq. Km. It shares boundaries with Srikalahasti, Chandragiri, Nagari, Satyavedu. mix of Red soil, Block cotton soil, Gravelly soil
profile.populationDesc: The total population is 3,77,349, with approximately 31.12% residing in rural areas and 68.87% in urban areas. There are 93,084 households, and the sex ratio is 996 females per 1,000 males. The literacy rate stands at 85.27% .
profile.administrationDesc: Tirupati Constituency is one of the seven assembly constituencies in Tirupati District. It includes Tirupati Urban mandal,Tirupati Rural mandal. Tirupati constituency comes under Tirupati Loksabha Constituency.
profile.educationHealthcareDesc:
• Tirupati is home to Sri Venkateswara University (SVU), a major public university offering diverse undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

• Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam (SPMVV), a dedicated women’s university, contributes to women's empowerment through higher education.

• Sri Venkateswara Vedic University, sponsored by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD), promotes traditional Vedic education.

• The city's educational infrastructure includes 305 schools, 81 colleges, 2 medical colleges, and 6 universities, ensuring wide access to quality education.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Economy at a Glance

Tirupati’s economy is driven by the service sector, contributing a dominant 87.3% to the Gross Value Added (GVA). Within this, tourism plays a central role, with trade, hotels, and restaurants contributing 25.15% of the GVA, highlighting its importance as a pilgrimage hub. Real estate ownership, driven by growing residential and commercial developments, adds 15% to the GVA.

The industrial sector, contributing 11.88%, is expanding, with opportunities in IT, manufacturing, and food processing. Digital IT infrastructure and the establishment of innovation hubs present significant growth potential, positioning Tirupati as a regional leader in tech and entrepreneurship.

Tirupati is uniquely positioned to capitalize on its dual strengths: a vibrant tourism economy and emerging technology and industrial sectors. With increasing investments in digital infrastructure and a booming start-up ecosystem, Tirupati is set to become a key economic and innovation hub.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Tirupati aims for a 13-15% annual GCDP growth rate, driven by key sectors like tourism, real estate, IT infrastructure, and education. Leveraging its strength as a pilgrimage hub, expanding digital infrastructure, and fostering sectors like technology, manufacturing, and start-ups, Tirupati is on track to become a vibrant, sustainable urban center with global appeal. This growth vision will transform the constituency into a dynamic economic and innovation hub by 2047.
